div.head: Wl art retr Inscr.
div.ab: Decreta domini regis Willelmi bastardi et emendaciones quas posuit in Anglia quae olim vocabatur Britannia. Hic eciam intimatur &c.
The decrees and legal reforms of our lord King William the Bastard, which he established in England, formerly called Britain. Notice is hereby given &c.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 244–245 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added; Robertson prints only the clauses that differ from Wl art: for 3.1–4, 10 and 12–15 she refers the reader to Wl art 3.1–4, 5 and 6–9.
